subject: gk
question: Which private bank launched a remote payment service named 'SMS Pay' for merchants on 26 November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yes Bank.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yes, Bank** has launched an **‘SMS Pay’** functionality on POS terminals, which would allow merchants to accept contactless and remote payments from their customers.
 
• It has partnered with French payment service company **Worldline** to launch the new facility.
 
• Customers can complete the payment through their domestic debit and credit cards.
 
• Through this service, local merchants can requests payment from their customers by entering their contact details.
 
• Following this an SMS would be sent to the customer's mobile number instantly for making payments. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yes Bank - **Parent company name **Yes Bank Limited**
 
• **Founder - **Rana Kapoor, Ashok Kapoor
 
• Established in 2004.
 
• Headquarters- **Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.**
 
• **MD and CEO - **Prashant Kumar
 
• **Chairman - **Sunil Mehta.
